task.text:
[0] Loss of function mutation of daf-16 (FOXO ortholog) canceled the life-extending effect of efl-1 (E2F1 ortholog) knockdown.

[1] Double mutants daf-16(mu86);tdp-1(ok803) were compared with daf-16(mu86).

[2] Loss of function mutation of daf-16 (FOXO ortholog) canceled the life-extending effect of efl-1 (E2F1 ortholog) knockdown.

[3] log rank p-value<0.0001 (daf-16(mu86) vs daf-16(mu86);tdp-1(ok803))

[4] rank p-value=0.003. For RNAi experiments, animals were maintained on RNAi feeding strains. RNAi plates consisted of NGM supplemented with 1mM β-D-isothiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) and 25 μg/ml carbenicillin.

[5] rank p-value=0,01. For RNAi experiments, animals were maintained on RNAi feeding strains. RNAi plates consisted of NGM supplemented with 1mM β-D-isothiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) and 25 μg/ml carbenicillin.

[6] Inactivation of either mdl-1 or mxl-1 failed to confer longevity in daf-16(mgDf47) null mutant animals. Corroborates the conclusion that lifespan extension after loss of MDL-1:MXL-1 requires DAF-16.

[7] Overexpressed dFOXO, a downstream effector of IIS, in the adult Drosophila fat body, which increased life-span and reduced fecundity of females but had no effect on male life-span. The role of FOXO transcription factors and the adipose tissue are therefore evolutionarily conserved in the regulation of aging, and reduction of insulin/insulin-like growth factor signaling in the adult is sufficient to mediate its effects on life-span and fecundity. Induced expression of dFOXO in the fat body from the onset of adulthood increased life-span and reduced fecundity of female flies by 20 to 50% and by 50%, respectively.

[8] Total N=545, foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM).

[9] Total N=258, foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM).

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
